_about: PC-only deviations from the canonical Fire/Air numbers (docs/design/reconciled/data/arena/spells-*.csv and schools-combat.json, which carry VR's numbers). Keys: '<spellId>.<column>' (castS, cooldownS, mana, damage, telegraphS, rangeM) or '<school>.identity.<dotted key>'. Unknown keys fail at load. Parity suites run with ArenaState.balance = 'canonical', which ignores this file. Every key is a deviation and a CR candidate for VR (docs/concepts/W8-fire-air-dual-channel.md section 8). W8 lane B (2026-10-23): darts cut to the damage a VR seated dome lets through (PC has no dome) and halved in mana so the rivals can afford their kit; Air Form made free and quick, the one defensive row either rival plays (its reaction wards cover only the few threats seen longer than its reaction delay). W8 lane X (2026-10-23): AI reaction now runs at pace, so the rivals ward again; every key re-checked against the reacting AI and Lio's dart re-cut 1.1 -> 0.9 to bring the final's win rate back into range. Spark combat-system-depth WP2 (2026-10-23): Brennic and Lio now play authored builds (rival-builds.json) whose plans press the dart deliberately, so fire_bolt.damage 2.1 -> 1 (the 2.1 was tuned for the catalogue Brennic's random picks; at 2.1 the fire light build streams darts to 97 % rival wins). Evidence: docs/waves/W8-evidence/named.json; builds census: npm --prefix packages/core run census:builds. D1 exchange windows (2026-10-24): `exchange` is the PC-only close-duel rule (packages/core/src/arena/exchange.ts): a clean hit at closeRangeM or less opens the defender's window, which for guardS stops guardReduction of the attacker's next guardHits close blows; parity (balance canonical) and Water-only states ignore it.
